items.definition:
Powdered tobacco for sniffing
He took a pinch of snuff from the box.

Abstinence from alcoholic drink; moderation or self-restraint
The temperance movement advocated for the prohibition of alcohol.

the time at which something is most powerful or successful
At the zenith of his career, he was the most celebrated artist.

the state or practice of refraining from extramarital, or all, sexual intercourse
She vowed to maintain her chastity until marriage.

the property or power of conducting heat, electricity, or sound
Copper has high electrical conductivity.

the action or process of distributing or spreading things or people over a wide area
The dispersal of seeds is important for plant reproduction.

A type of game bird; a complaint
The hunter aimed at the grouse in the bushes.

A freshwater fish of the carp family
The angler caught a large ide in the river.

A person who supports or practices imperialism
Critics denounced him as an imperialist for his expansionist policies.

an official appointed to investigate complaints against public authorities or organizations
If you have a complaint, you can contact the ombudsman's office.

a former title of a Turkish officer of high rank
The pasha commanded a large army in the Ottoman Empire.

the action of signing or giving formal consent to a treaty, contract, or agreement, making it officially valid
The treaty requires ratification by all member states.

a very small amount
He didn't care a whit about her opinion.

a thing that causes disgust or hatred
Slavery is an abomination.

an attitude of distrust toward human sincerity or integrity
His cynicism made it hard for him to trust anyone.

the state of having two parts
The film explores the duality of good and evil.

the act of destroying completely
The extermination of pests is crucial for public health.

the separate part of a Muslim household reserved for women
The historical drama depicted life within a royal harem.

a microscopic organism, especially a bacterium, virus, or fungus
Bacteria are a type of microorganism.

a movement toward modifying traditional beliefs or forms in the arts
Modernism influenced art, literature, and architecture.

voluntary self-punishment inflicted as an outward expression of repentance for wrongdoing
He performed acts of penance to atone for his sins.

a representation of a plan or theory in the form of an outline or model
The database schema defines the structure of the data.

a star that suddenly increases greatly in brightness
Astronomers observed a distant supernova.

a member of a religious military order
The Knights Templar were powerful during the Crusades.

the study of poisons
He specialized in toxicology at university.

betrayal of trust
His actions were seen as an act of treachery.

a violent or sudden change or disruption
The political upheaval led to widespread protests.

a thin decorative covering of fine wood
The table had a walnut veneer.

the state of being thick, sticky, and semifluid in consistency
Honey has a high viscosity.

a military officer who acts as an administrative assistant to a senior officer
The general's adjutant handled all the correspondence.

the act of awakening or exciting someone
The sudden noise caused an arousal of suspicion.

the worst part or chief impact of a specified thing
The small businesses bore the brunt of the economic downturn.

a modulation or inflection of the voice; a rhythmic flow of a sequence of sounds or words
The speaker's voice had a soothing cadence.

a secret way of writing
The message was written in a complex cipher.

a flowing together of two or more things
The town is located at the confluence of two rivers.

goods that are imported or exported illegally
Customs officers seized a large amount of contraband.

the process of decline or deterioration
The doctor observed signs of tissue degeneration.

the complete destruction of something
The eradication of the disease is a global goal.

the quality of being female
She embraced her femininity.

an increase or addition, especially one of a series on a fixed scale
The salary will increase by annual increments.

the action of breathing in
Deep inhalation can help calm your nerves.

the state of being drunk or poisoned
Alcohol intoxication impairs judgment.

the quality of being average or not very good
He was tired of the mediocrity of his daily routine.

a system of society or government in which men hold the power and women are largely excluded from it
Feminist scholars often analyze the structures of patriarchy.

a person who is easily taken advantage of or blamed for something
He felt like a patsy after being tricked into doing all the work.

the method and practice of teaching, especially as an academic subject or theoretical concept
The new teaching methods reflect modern pedagogy.

a person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by the generous donation of money to good causes
The wealthy philanthropist donated millions to charity.

a gentle slope leading from the base of mountains to a region of flat land
The city is located in the piedmont region, at the foot of the mountains.

People of Color
The conference aimed to amplify the voices of POC in tech.

Plural of serum; the clear, yellowish fluid portion of blood.
The lab collected multiple sera samples for analysis.

A person who studies theology.
The theologian gave a lecture on ancient religious texts.

something that causes pain or suffering
The disease was a terrible affliction.

a final and decisive battle; a catastrophic conflict
Some people fear a nuclear armageddon.

A leafy shelter or recess in a garden or wood
They sat in the rose bower, enjoying the shade.

A style of sofa with deep buttoned leather upholstery
He relaxed on the comfortable leather chesterfield.

A device or drug serving to prevent pregnancy
Modern medicine offers various forms of contraceptive.

An argument, idea, or theme used to create a contrast with the main element
His optimistic view served as a counterpoint to her pessimism.

the splitting of an atomic nucleus
Nuclear fission releases a tremendous amount of energy.

A hard, brittle, silvery-gray metallic element
Manganese is an important component in steel production.

A microscopic particle with at least one dimension less than 100 nanometers
Scientists are developing new drugs using nanoparticles.

the state of being famous
The artist achieved international renown for her sculptures.

a person who is blamed for the wrongdoings of others
The manager made the new employee a scapegoat for the team's failure.

a substance produced and discharged by a gland or organ
The gland is responsible for the secretion of hormones.

the quality or fact of being able to grip something firmly; grip
Her tenacity helped her overcome many obstacles.
